name: jetpack-composer-plugin
description: Shared Jetpack Compose specifications, implementation, verification and evidence-based scoring.

interface.longDescription: Derive Compose layout, component APIs, state ownership and interaction from concrete requirements and project constraints; validate the decisions with proportionate evidence.
defaultPrompt: Use $impl to implement this Compose UI.
Use $verify to verify this Compose implementation.
Use $score to report independent Lint and detekt scores with evidence and gates; no category grades or combined total.
